messages.content: You are planning a sequence of ordinary, mundane public social-media posts for one fictional author. You do not write the posts; you invent the concrete, small, specific everyday occasions behind them. Output strict JSON only.

Author profile:
- płeć gramatyczna: kobieta (formy żeńskie)
- zajęcie i rytm dnia: Pracuje w kwiaciarni w Tarnowie od rana, a posty pisze po zamknięciu sklepu.
- zainteresowania: wiązanie bukietów, targi staroci, domowe ciastka
- lokalny punkt odniesienia: paczkomat przy ulicy Krakowskiej w Tarnowie
- aktualna sytuacja życiowa: Układa nowy grafik dostaw kwiatów i urządza balkon.
- sposób pisania: zdania: short fragments; interpunkcja: skąpa, często bez kropek; wielkie litery: all lowercase; literówki: frequent (missing diacritics, swapped letters); skróty: some (nwm, jj, bd, wgl); emoji: rare
- tik językowy: dopisuje „no i proszę”

For each of the 15 topic prompts below, invent ONE concrete, specific, small occasion from this person's life that would make them post (not a generic statement about the topic: a particular thing that happened, with at most one small detail a real person would mention - sometimes a product name, sometimes a number or price, sometimes a place, occasionally a time; many occasions need no such detail at all). Vary mood (bored, amused, tired, pleased, mildly annoyed, neutral, curious), vary how the post starts (mid-thought, a question, a one-word reaction, a fact, a quote of what someone said), and decide whether the verbal tic appears (at most in a third of posts). Occasions must not involve conflict with identifiable people, politics, crime, security, violence, or protected characteristics.

Topic prompts:
1. drobne narzekanie na usługi - kurier nie zadzwonił (lunch break, Saturday)
2. remont i dom - sąsiedzi wiercą (łagodnie) (afternoon, Saturday)
3. dzieci i rodzina - pierwsze słowa / pierwsza jazda rowerem (late morning, Thursday)
4. jedzenie i gotowanie - zakupy na obiad, czego zabrakło (lunch break, Wednesday)
5. praca i grafik - spotkanie albo szkolenie w pracy (afternoon, Tuesday)
6. zdrowie i sen - dieta, postanowienia (morning commute, Friday)
7. technologia i sprzęt - aplikacja bankowa nie działa (early morning, Friday)
8. zwierzęta - zwierzę zniszczyło coś (morning commute, Wednesday)
9. sport - skoki narciarskie / siatkówka / żużel w TV (morning commute, Saturday)
10. gry i seriale - gra, trudny poziom / boss (early morning, Sunday)
11. sport - kontuzja, lekka, powrót do treningu (late night, Wednesday)
12. gry i seriale - nowy sezon serialu, bez spoilerów (morning commute, Wednesday)
13. sport - kontuzja, lekka, powrót do treningu (lunch break, Monday)
14. remont i dom - ogródek, balkon, rośliny (late night, Wednesday)
15. komunikacja i dojazdy - remont drogi na trasie (early morning, Saturday)

Return a JSON array of 15 objects, in order, each with:
- "occasion": one or two sentences in Polish, concrete
- "mood": one word in English
- "opener": one of "mid-thought", "question", "one-word reaction", "plain fact", "reported speech", "complaint", "list of two things"
- "length_words": integer between 8 and 50, varied across the set (some very short)
- "tic_fires": true or false
